result.summary:
This round pulled the four structure items forward in their smallest form, in three commits on top of 0ef304b. Nothing was pushed, re-baselined or loosened, and the gate is not fully met: bench-75 fan_x is 8 against a must of 6, and nested-chain lateral_x is 2 against a must of 0. Every change is behind the block switch, so the default build renders byte-identically (everything_renders_as_before_with_blocks_off passes) and guard.sh printed GUARD: ALL GREEN before each commit.

The four items are:
- the track packing of a gap (G2);
- corner legs and the spill order of an over-full side (2.8);
- title-clear entries for members wholly under the chip (2.8 rule 2), with their F2 jog room in TD/BT;
- the X2.5 column: tried and not kept.

Along the way the round also added fan order across levels (O6), and in block mode turned off the router's many-crossings search and made the respace keep the drawn order.

Targets met:
- fan_x is 0 on the whole analog family (v2 was 1) and on all seven permutations of the public fixture.
- dense-td fan_x is 1 (round 4: 18, start 1) and wide-frames is 1 (start 1); every other repository fixture is 0.
- notes/nested-composite's choice no longer shares a corner (hard zeros 4 -> 0).
- Every crossing must and xframe_runs 0 hold. Analog 17/20, v2 14/17, perm-b 19/23, perm-e 17/22, public 6/7, bench-75 210/325, dense-td 53/74.6, dense-lr 17/51.5.
- Under dense-td's six edge-line shuffles, crossings are 46-54 and xframe_runs is 0 on all six.
- The local judge reports 155 checks, 0 must-fail, 8 targets missed.

Regressions to know about:
- The analog and perm-a/c/d crossings rose from 15 to 17. That is inside the must of 20 but above the target of 16, and which item causes it was not isolated.
- On two of dense-td's six shuffles, fan_x is 4 (the start shows 0 and 1 there). The cause is the ports stage's heading order of the turned edge n31->n16. A fix that measures headings from the side's middle made the fixtures worse (bench-75 8 -> 10, dense-td 1 -> 3) and was reverted; the tree is clean at 34f322b.
- With the switch on, the analog's static scene time rose about 3.8 ms (fastest run 6.43 -> 10.24 ms, limit 11.58). It is within the limit with less headroom.

Dense-td's fan crossings were measured stage by stage before building: ortho 7, repair 12, nudge 22, comb 18 at the start, and builder 19, ports 13, ortho 4, repair 6, nudge 3, comb 1 now.

Suite-on tests: lib has 1146 passed and 8 failed (round 4: 10); tests/quality.rs has 9 passed and 6 failed. There is no new failure, and the four new tests pass. The comb test's scene half now passes and only its route() half fails. In block_fixtures_are_not_drawn_worse, the only static failure left is notes/wide-frames' note links.

Perf: single perf.sh runs went over a limit on dense-td route_ms and on lr, stress and fanout-frames drag. Run alternately with the start binary on the same box (dense-td, lr, stress), they match it, so I treat them as noise.

The generated sweep is unchanged (SWEEP_ADDED_MAX 9 stands). The starts table and the bulk corpus were not re-run.

The checkpoint report is rewritten at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-flowmaid/cac93b13-7009-5470-94b5-477c61df0333/scratchpad/b12/reports/checkpoint-A1.md. It gives every number with its cause and names exactly what b12a2-geometry no longer builds: G2; the corner legs; the spill order and cornered lone end; F2 in TD/BT; title-clear rule 2; O6; and the block-mode router and respace tuning. result.summary:
Fix round 5 of b12a1-structure. Four new commits on ccr-ccc6d89a-5cxd7e (after 34f322b). All changes sit behind the block layout, so the default build still draws exactly what it drew before (`everything_renders_as_before_with_blocks_off` passes, and guard printed GUARD: ALL GREEN before each commit).

Both blocking items are fixed in the suite-on run:
- **#1:** bench-75 static fan_x went 8 -> 4 (the must is 6 or less). Its crossings went 210 -> 204 and overlap pairs 1 -> 0. Cause, measured stage by stage: the ortho stage put a turned step first in its channel, so its run lay 5 px beside two runs of svc5's fan. The repair then rerouted those two across the fan. New `ortho::part_runs` reorders such steps without adding crossings.
- **#2:** blocks/nested-chain lateral_x went 2 -> 0, with 0 crossings. X2.5 is now built in the order (`layout::BlockOrder::clear_titles`), and the layout reserves room for the run past the chip (`layout::title_room`, capped). The ortho stage now keeps title-crossing columns where the layout put them (pinned in `straighten` and in `flow_path`).
- **#3 (partly):** title-clear rule 1 now applies by breadth alone to title-row members (`ports::title_row_side`). Results:
  - x4-fan-levels: fan_x 2 -> 0, crossings 2 -> 0.
  - dense-td: fan_x 1 -> 0, crossings 53 -> 48.
  - dense-td shuffles s1-s6: fan_x 0 10 0 0 0 3, against 1 1 1 0 0 1 at the start. s4, s5 and s6 improved; s2 regressed (see items_skipped).

Other checks:
- **Analog family:** fan_x is 0 on all inputs. The local judge reports 0 must-fail lines (analog 17 -> 15 crossings, perm-b 19 -> 18, breadths within 10 %).
- **Repository fixtures, start -> now:** x_drawn 584 -> 332, fan_x 17 -> 5. Of those 5, bench-75 has 4 and notes/wide-frames has 1, which equals its start value.
- **Non-blocking items:**
  - #5: the TitleSides doc now sits on the struct and says it moves edge ends only.
  - #6: `quality::Report` is now `#[non_exhaustive]`.
  - #7: the pinned marquee test is back to the start's text and passes in both builds. The real cause was the test helper `path_d_points`, which sampled a long cubic too sparsely near its start. It now splits those wide steps only, so other tests see the same points.
- **Perf, two `perf.sh` runs (default build):**
  - bench-75: drag 17.6 / 19.0 ms (limit 25.3), route 10.5 / 11.4 ms (limit 15.8).
  - dense-td: drag 13.4 / 13.3 ms (limit 17.8).
  - All other files are inside their limits.
- **Block-mode scene_ms:** inside the budgets. The analog's fastest run was 10.4 ms against an 11.6 ms limit.

The checkpoint report /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-flowmaid/cac93b13-7009-5470-94b5-477c61df0333/scratchpad/b12/reports/checkpoint-A1.md is rewritten, including the starts table. checkpoint-S.md (the corridor spike) is unchanged.
